notes.title: Game version 1.1
notes.content:
Balanced the early maps' easy level, to reduce the difficulty of gliding for beginners. 
Fixed various UI interactions and added keys to facilitate the selection of Hang Glider skins. 
Chinese and German languages added, plus improved translations for all languages. 
Improved loading times for various maps, fixed small errors and squished minor bugs. 
Improved the overall stability of the game.
